title: BEFORE the beginning and AFTER the end. that IS the null sphere.

do_not_reinvent.sphere: /data/null-d-sphere.json — 0-D point. Klein disc. prior/later both. already the organ.
do_not_reinvent.stop: /data/stop-time-null.json — stop time is the null. do not mint a fifth tense.
do_not_reinvent.void: /data/three-lens-pass.json — all three open on empty. do not retell.
do_not_reinvent.eon: /data/eon-bounce-wide.json — in and out wrap here. not a new clock.

yes.before_begin: what precedes the first 1. pale. no start yet.
yes.after_end: what follows the last 1. pale. no sequel.
yes.same: those two are ONE. the null sphere. not two rooms.

not.two_times: not a before-clock and an after-clock.
not.new_now: not another NOW. WAS already has fossils. this is 0-D, not a tense.

wrap.eon: bounce in toward before-begin. bounce out through after-end. they are the same cup.
wrap.klein: no inside. the ends meet as a point. A.

law: before-beginning = after-end = null sphere = A. if they split we minted a second 0.
pull: keep one pale. the eons wrap through it. do not name a dawn and a dusk as two holes.
